question:
Which of the following letter-clusters will replace the question mark (?) and complete the following letter-cluster series?

EU, CS, YQ, SO, ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic :

 
• First letter → Next alternate even number series is subtracted from the position values according to English alphabetic series starting with (2).
 
• Second letter → (2) is subtracted from the position values according to English alphabetic series.

So,

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c62fd171ef4d37868995bff780473f066462aec0535efb8cdf943297a3e591a.png] 

​Hence, "**KM**" is the correct answer.
